explanation: Implemented the scoped Commons CLI 1.9.0 Python module matching the frozen contract and source specifications. The implementation includes: 1) ParseException and subclasses (UnrecognizedOptionException, AmbiguousOptionException, MissingArgumentException, MissingOptionException, AlreadySelectedException) with exact Java class hierarchy, names, and field accessor signatures. 2) Option, OptionGroup, Options, CommandLine, and DefaultParser implementing the exact methods specified. 3) OptionValidator implementing validation rules identical to the Java source, raising ValueError on failure. 4) DefaultParser parsing workflow preserving per-call reset, option cloning, handling of concatenated options, partial long options matching, required options tracking, and value assignment to individual CommandLine instances.
